info.name: Third-Party Vendor Risk Assessor Postman Collection
info.description:
Continuous security, privacy, and compliance risk assessment for 
third-party vendors. Tracks every SaaS tool, cloud provider, and 
integration partner in your supply chain. Automatically monitors 
security posture via public sources (SOC2 reports, breach databases, 
security ratings), flags compliance gaps, and enforces data processing 
agreement (DPA) renewals. Prevents the classic "we forgot that vendor 
had access to customer data" incident.

OpenAPI version: 3.0.3
